Bash("/c/Program Files/PostgreSQL/18/bin/psql" -U postgres -d wego_dev -c "
-- Mark routes as completed for rider 13 (all orders delivered)
UPDATE delivery_routes 
SET status = ''completed'', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE rider_id = 13 AND status IN (''pending'', ''active'');

-- Also clear routes for rider 10 so they can start fresh
DELETE FROM delivery_routes WHERE rider_id = 10;

-- Check remaining routes
SELECT dr.id, dr.rider_id, u.phone, dr.status 
FROM delivery_routes dr 
JOIN users u ON dr.rider_id = u.id 
ORDER BY dr.created_at DESC LIMIT 10;
")

Bash("/c/Program Files/PostgreSQL/18/bin/psql" -U postgres -d wego_dev -c "
-- Mark orders as ready for testing
UPDATE orders 
SET order_status = ''ready'', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id IN (1136, 1137, 1138, 44);

-- Verify
SELECT o.id, o.order_status, o.student_id, u.name as customer, 
       COALESCE(l.latitude, sa.latitude) as lat,
       COALESCE(l.longitude, sa.longitude) as lon
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN users u ON o.student_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN locations l ON u.location_id = l.id
LEFT JOIN student_addresses sa ON o.delivery_address = sa.address_label AND sa.student_id = o.student_id
WHERE o.order_status = ''ready''
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC;
")
